The '''1D servo turret''' was a weapon turret manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. The stock configuration of CEC's [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] had two 1D servo turrets, one mounted ventrally and the other dorsally; both [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster]] and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] could be mounted on them.<ref name="MFOWMpg27" /> [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] mounted a pair of [[Dymek/Legends|Dymek]] double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] on the standard 1D servo turrets on his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Outrider/Legends|Outrider]]''.<ref name="EGVV" />
